label: レビュー：プロセス・用途
classification: A review centered on a capture or separation application, process configurations, operating requirements, module/system design, energy, or economics.
instructions: Organize the synthesis from feed/application requirements through process configuration to product requirements and system performance. Identify whether energy and cost values are experimental, simulated, or estimated.

sections.heading: 🗾このレビューの要点
sections.instruction: Summarize the process-level conclusions and main design implications.

sections.heading: 🏭対象用途と供給条件
sections.instruction: Describe the application, feed composition/concentration, flow, pressure, impurities, and product requirements where reported.

sections.heading: 🔄プロセス構成と設計変数
sections.instruction: Summarize process stages, flow arrangements, vacuum/compression/sweep/recycle, and important design variables.

sections.heading: ⚡エネルギー・コスト・環境評価
sections.instruction: Report system-level energy, cost, recovery, purity, and environmental metrics with units, assumptions, and whether they are modeled or measured.

sections.heading: 🔍実用化への課題
sections.instruction: List scale-up, integration, reliability, and evidence gaps discussed by the authors.
